ModMetaData.name: The Slorg
ModMetaData.author: kanid99
ModMetaData.description:
We are the Slorg. Your biological and technological distinctiveness will be added to our own.
Adds the Slorg, a cybernetic hive-mind xenotype.
- Assimilate: drones can inject a downed enemy or a prisoner with nanoprobes, turning them into a Slorg drone and adding them to the collective. - Collective knowledge: each drone works at the collective's best level in every skill. The collective only keeps a skill while the drone that knows it is alive and linked. If that drone dies, is captured or leaves, the collective loses that skill. - Collective strength: the more drones are linked, the stronger every drone gets. A lone drone is isolated and weakened. - Shared traits: useful traits such as industrious, tough or careful shooter spread from the drone that has them to the whole collective, for as long as that drone stays linked.
Requires Biotech and Harmony.
